text:
Marta: Heads-up — partner onboarding needs a soft guarantee for 8 H100 slots in eu-west1 for next Tue 09:00 UTC. Can we confirm capacity + quota?

Raj: Which exact SKU / AZs do they need? vendor prefers contiguous AZs for perf.

Marta: SKU is h100-v2 (nv-link not required). Prefer eu-west1-b/c, can fall back to eu-west3 if needed. It's for a 4-hour daily window for two weeks.

Leo: Quick snapshot: eu-west1 total H100 pool = 24, currently reserved = 12 (longstanding reserved pools), active ephemeral = 6, free = 6. So short by 2 if they want 8 exclusive. :thinking_face:

Tim: We could: 1) create a short reservation (terraform) to carve 6 guaranteed and 2 in fallback region OR 2) do soft overcommit and rely on preemption fallback. Option 1 needs procurement + PO.

Marta: Option 1 preferred (partner SLA). Raj can you check vendor lead-time? @Raj

Raj: Pinged procurement vendor contact. Vendor reply (copied):
"We can allocate 8 H100 within eu-west1 but need a PO and 24-48h lead time to claim the quota on our side. If you need AZ affinity, add that note. Otherwise we can split across eu-west1+eu-west3 immediately."

Raj: So constraint is paperwork + PO by EOD Mon to meet Tue morning.

Aya: Estimated incremental cost rough calc: 8 H100 reserved ~ $6,400/day (on our committed rates) for that 4h window daily we'd amortize to ~ $1,100/day. Need quick greenlight from finance for one-off partner spend.

Marta: Thanks. If finance signs off, Tim can you open the infra ticket and start the terraform change? Keep it reversible.

Tim: Will do. Creating INFRA-8421 now and will attach TF plan. Quick TF snippet I'll use: 
```hcl
resource "google_compute_reservation" "h100-partner" {
  name = "partner-h100-euw1"
  zone = "eu-west1-b"
  specific_reservation {
    count = 6
    machine_type = "n1-standard-16" # placeholder, actual is custom for H100
  }
  resource_type = "GPUS"
  guest_accelerator {
    type  = "h100-v2"
    count = 6
  }
}
```
I'll leave 2 as ephemeral and tag them as fallback in eu-west3.

Leo: FYI, if we reserve 6 here we'll reduce free pool to 0 in eu-west1 for the window; other teams might get queued. I'll post on #all-hands if we proceed.

Raj: Vendor responded to my follow-up: "We can accept a soft PO (email acceptance) and mark as pending — final invoice after allocation." Want me to send the soft PO template?

Marta: Yes please, send soft PO and CC @Aya. Also include: AZ affinity = eu-west1-b preferred, fallbacks eu-west1-c and eu-west3-a.

Aya: I'll review the PO now. If wording matches spend policy I can sign off by 10:15am.

Tim: INFRA-8421 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-8421 — assigning to @Tim and @Marta. I'll attach TF plan and a canary script that pins two fallback instances in eu-west3.

vendor-bot: VB-9933: vendor acknowledged PO draft, tentative allocation hold placed for 48h.

Marta: Great. Action items: Raj send PO template -> Aya review -> Tim apply TF (reserve 6 eu-west1) -> Leo announce potential impact. Aim: PO submitted by 10:30am so vendor can finalize.

Leo: Quick follow-up question — are we okay to reduce nightly batch capacity tonight to free up ephemeral slots if needed?

Marta: We can shift noncritical nightly runs to eu-west3 for tonight. I'll schedule the shift.

Raj: Sending PO now. ETA vendor confirmation email in ~15m.

Aya: Reviewed and OK. Signed soft PO and emailed vendor. :thumbsup:

vendor-bot: VB-9933: allocation confirmed, vendor ETA 36h for hard claim.

Tim: I'll hold the TF apply until vendor confirms hard claim, then apply with a canary window. Will post plan in the ticket.

Marta: Thanks everyone — I'll coordinate partner kick-off once the hard claim is in. :raised_hands:
